source.title: Changes in WCA Officers (May 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

Following [recent changes to the WCA’s Board of Directors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/changes-in-the-board-of-directors-may-2026), the Board has refreshed appointments to the WCA’s Officer roles. Officer positions are specific legal roles related to running the WCA non-profit organization.

Dan Smith has been appointed as WCA Executive Director. Dan had previously been acting as the WCA’s Chief Operating Officer. This appointment better reflects Dan’s leadership across all WCA Volunteers and aligns his role with the structures in the WCA’s governance documents. There is no change to Dan’s day-to-day duties and responsibilities.

Abdullah Gulab has been appointed as WCA Chair. Abdullah was previously WCA Treasurer and WCA Vice-Chair.

Oliver Hexter has been appointed as WCA Secretary.

Sachin Arvind has been appointed as WCA Treasurer.

Glib Vedmid and Rubén López de Juan have been appointed as WCA Vice-Chairs.

With their Board terms coming to an end soon, Nick Silvestri has vacated the position of WCA Chair and Blake Thompson has vacated the position of WCA Secretary. The Board wishes to thank Nick and Blake for their service to the WCA through their Director and Officer roles.

translation.title: WCA 干事变动（2026 年 5 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

随着 [WCA 董事会近期的人员变动](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/changes-in-the-board-of-directors-may-2026)，董事会重新任命了 WCA 各干事岗位。干事岗位是与 WCA 这一非营利组织的运作有关的特定法定职务。

Dan Smith 已被任命为 WCA 执行董事。Dan 此前担任 WCA 首席运营官。这一任命更准确地体现了 Dan 对全体 WCA 志愿者的领导职责，也使其岗位与 WCA 治理文件中的组织架构保持一致。Dan 的日常工作与职责没有改变。

Abdullah Gulab 已被任命为 WCA 主席。Abdullah 此前担任 WCA 财务主管及副主席。

Oliver Hexter 已被任命为 WCA 秘书。

Sachin Arvind 已被任命为 WCA 财务主管。

Glib Vedmid 和 Rubén López de Juan 已被任命为 WCA 副主席。

由于董事任期即将结束，Nick Silvestri 已卸任 WCA 主席，Blake Thompson 已卸任 WCA 秘书。董事会感谢 Nick 和 Blake 在担任董事及干事期间为 WCA 作出的贡献。
